scope: Reference training reuse into a new session; independent source, production-consumer probe, and targeted tests. No A04 physical result claimed.

source_authority.evidence: _load_completed_reference_training requires scientific schema, requested original session/task/backend/initialization, same scientific hash and reference manifest, checksum-bound source private artifact, recovered original training summary/checkpoint equality, and unchanged checkpoint bytes.

scientific_vs_execution_identity.evidence: Current scientific hash is computed before adding four-field reference_training_source execution-placement marker. Original train public comparison ignores only job_id/execution_device/gpu_process_binding for explicit reuse; all training science stays equal. No new task/robot special case.

original_execution_preserved.evidence: New artifact retains original train_job public spec/metadata/result, including old execution environment and GPU binding. bind_eval_spec_to_checkpoint verifies scientific lineage against new eval and checkpoint execution lineage against old source train spec. It changes only new eval checkpoint binding.

real_recovery_read_only.evidence: SubprocessRunner.recover_completed_train calls _run_train_once(reuse_existing_summary=True). _execute_summary_job reads and validates old summary and returns before _clear_existing_summary, stale output removal, and _run_job; backend/device/training validation uses original train spec.

new_evaluation_and_empty_ledger.evidence: Formal host supplies no new train attempt scope and all three new evaluation scopes. Three new phase calls occur once; resume calls zero additional eval. New eval plan uses new session and GPU binding; no old ledger is copied or created.

resume_binding.evidence: Reuse is paired and mutually exclusive with complete Genesis import. Reload revalidates original source, compares persisted source marker and exact original train evidence, plus current eval environment/contract/GPU. Omission of source args fails explicit source drift.

failure_cases.evidence: Targeted tests reject changed scientific budget, changed recovered summary, changed checkpoint bytes before any fresh eval. Existing partial-directory and unmatched-completed-training failures retain behavior.

real_cost_consumer.evidence: Verified marker excludes only old reference training from validated_job_cost_artifacts. Actual collect_actual_cost_usage consumes three new on-disk eval attempt receipts with empty ledger; zero train jobs/steps, no unconsumed evidence or conservative charge. Source old train ID remains in private identity/evidence, not charged work.

run_and_resume_wiring.evidence: CLI -> GenerationLaunchConfig -> prepare_generation_genesis -> prepare_session_genesis. run_generation_session and terminal resume call prepare_generation_genesis then real actual-cost consumer. No isolated helper-only path.

budget_reservation_vs_actual.evidence: Current cost plan may reserve unused reference-train capacity; actual accounting follows new attempt receipts and does not charge retained historical work. Conservative unused capacity is distinct from actual scientific work.

limitations: Reference training and GPU evaluations use existing unit fixture objects; no physical run claimed.
Actual cost consumer and on-disk attempt journals are production functions; operation-allocation v2 layer is reviewed statically and awaits target runtime.

probe_fixture_note: The base reference unit backend uses underscore phase job IDs; the experiment probe uses a tiny fixture backend override with production hyphen phase IDs so eval_seed_units_for_job executes without monkeypatching its consumer. No product source changes.
limits: GPU execution, actual A04 source-byte receipts and three-phase scores are not available in this review.
Probe uses existing fake train/eval fixtures; actual recover_completed_train no-write guarantee is source-reviewed here and must also hold on retained A03 evidence at launch.

The probe runs the production actual-cost consumer with operation reserve layer disabled; v2 operation reservation/allocation is reviewed through the formal path and remains part of live A04 acceptance.
This is not five-round acceptance and does not assert unchanged reference performance across executions.

review_scope_correction.initial_gap: The initial six reuse tests patched recover_completed_train. The earlier source review established no-write ordering but did not follow the GPU summary validators with execution_context=None. The prior PASS therefore did not establish that retained bound reference training could actually be recovered.
review_scope_correction.historical_results_preserved: Original six-test results, cost-consumer probe and old source hashes remain as originally recorded; they do not prove successful A04 launch.

actual_counterexample.error: reusable train summary is invalid: unbound summary cannot claim a GPU process binding
actual_counterexample.cause: recover_completed_train intentionally does not acquire a new execution context, but summary validators previously inferred expected binding only from that live context and rejected the valid original GPU-bound summary.

fix_review.binding_authority: Only the reuse branch receives reused_gpu_process_binding from the original train_spec. If an actual execution context already exists, that context still wins. Fresh launch never takes the reuse value and still requires actual context binding.
fix_review.summary_validation: Private GPU binding is parsed and compared exactly to expected_binding; original owned_process_identity is validated with group-leader requirement, with no new-PID assertion for already completed training. Normal live Linux launch still requires child PID equality.
fix_review.no_dummy_execution: No fake _GpuJobExecutionContext, lease, physical UUID or new attempt is created. Recovery remains a read of prior evidence. It neither claims a new lease duration nor checks whether the old completed PID is currently alive.
fix_review.actual_probe: The new test executes the real SubprocessRunner.recover_completed_train and complete _run_train_once/_execute_summary_job path with a retained GPU-bound reference summary, full budget and original owned-process evidence. It checks output evidence and exact original file contents/mtime/set; run_owned_process, attempt creation and summary clearing are trapped.
fix_review.negative_cases: Wrong original GPU binding and unbound job claiming a binding both fail. Existing normal bound launch, completed-attempt recovery and unbound train/eval rejection tests pass.
fix_review.pre_fix_reproduction: Removing only the new reused_gpu_process_binding argument in an experiment-local wrapper reproduces the exact A04 error through the same real-runner test; restoring current wiring passes.
not_yet_claimed: New source has recovered the actual A03 Linux summary.
New A05 three-phase evaluation or five-round completion.
